description: Defines the interface and classes for an asynchronous IO broker, including configuration, registration, and deregistration of file descriptors, with callback mechanisms for data and error events.

classes.name: io_broker
classes.description: Interface for an asynchronous IO broker managing file descriptor events.

classes.name: subscriber
classes.description: RAII handle for registered file descriptors, automatically deregisters on destruction.

methods.name: register_fd
methods.description: Registers a file descriptor with the IO broker, providing callbacks for data and error events.

methods.name: unregister_fd
methods.description: Unregisters a file descriptor from the IO broker, optionally signaling completion.
